item.title: “市场通行证（Marketplace Pass）与 Realms Plus：2026年8月版”
item.description: August brings a packed lineup for Minecraft Marketplace Pass and Realms Plus, with everything from the hardcore survival challenge of RLCraft Bedrock Edition to creative building, automation, and cozy living. Explore new adventures with add-ons like Huggy & Friends, Warpstones, and Auto Factory, transform your worlds with the medieval-inspired Excalibur texture pack, and customize your character with fresh skins, mermaid makeovers, and spooky skeleton-themed cosmetics. Whether you're battling for survival, building dream homes, expanding your farms, or simply collecting new ways to play, this month’s collection is overflowing with content for every kind of Minecraft player.
item.content:encoded:
原标题：MARKETPLACE PASS AND REALMS PLUS: AUGUST 2026

作者：James Nouch

原文：https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/marketplace-content-august-2026

[

{

"id": "t0000",

"text": "八月又到了，阳光明媚，我最近再次联系上了过去的一位朋友。换句话说，一切都在按照那位神秘的算命者告诉我的那样发展。”

Some games need no introduction, and yet my cold-hearted editors insist that I write them anyway, even though I'm extremely tired. So, here's [RLCraft Bedrock Edition V1.2 by Honeyfrost](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/honeyfrost/rlcraft-bedrock-edition-1.2/062d87b7-819a-437d-9493-2a6603449220), widely regarded as one of the most accomplished - and hardcore - survival experiences around. Expect a transformative experience in which you'll find yourself working doubly hard to gather even the most basic materials, all while fending off attacks from some seriously scary mobs throughout the day and night. Adapt to these harsh new realities and you'll uncover a deep levelling system and incredibly satisfying progression. If you can survive long enough to see it, I mean.

Ever wished you could click your fingers and watch skyscrapers, restaurants, and bustling stores burst into existence before your very eyes? Well, [Craftable City by Lifeboat](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/lifeboat/craftable-city/98033cf2-6d88-48e6-997b-49d97cfaa519) has helped me with the instant-skyscraper part, but according to a note from the developers they're unable to teach me how to click my fingers. The sight of my gleaming urban playground brings me comfort while I soundlessly slap my thumbs together.

The pale garden biome has been scaring even the most intrepid explorers (e.g. me, and people exactly like me) since 2024, but it's never looked quite so fabulous. That's all thanks to [Pale Garden House by Overtales Studio](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/overtales-studio/pale-garden-house/cd873272-c416-489f-8a6f-d59b4452d28e), which adds a heap of stylish yet cozy buildings to this otherwise spooky biome. Sure, the outdoors may still be packed with creakings trying to headbutt me into the ground, but who cares when I get to live in a modish (and fully furnished) estate.

Yet more luxury awaits in [Cozy Camp House by ThunderAy](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/thunderay/cozy-camp-house/f0bfaf4f-362b-4a06-a548-2c599dda18c7). Like a French lumberjack or a bear in an exquisitely tailored suit, this countryside home positively screams rustic chic. An outdoor pool, an elegant living area, and a dedicated target practice area complete the sumptuous package. C'est magnifique.

And then there's [Modern Mansion by Dodo Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/dodo-studios/modern-mansion/f2dac2ec-11cb-4499-b9e8-b66a57b93a23), which is the perfect tonic for those of us recovering from being repeatedly pulverised in RLCraft. Relax and unwind in a giant mansion packed with tasteful home furnishings, before taking a dip in the gorgeous multi-level swimming pool. All while trying not to dwell on how frightening and fast and weird-looking that giant scorpion was in RLCraft.

ADD-ONS

When I think about friends, I think about: fun, laughter, and lying on my back in a rowboat while we take turns saying what shapes we see in the clouds. Now, after spending some time with [Huggy & Friends Add-on by Spark Universe](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/spark-universe/huggy--friends-add--on/30d1852c-d8a5-4e29-8631-bc14d96d35f2), I think about: fear, running, teeth, they're going to catch me, I can't get away, and teeth again. Try it for yourself if you fancy facing off against the likes of Huggy Wuggy, Mommy Long Leg, and The Doctor. Just don't say I didn't warn you.

Now I've thought about this a lot, and I've come to the conclusion that teleportation is the ultimate superpower. After all, super strength is pretty neat, but the Hulk still has to wait in line at the airport with his wallet and belt in one of those grey plastic trays. [Warpstones Add-on by Mythicus](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/mythicus/warpstones-add--on/d1b99d77-3c9e-43b7-8e74-211398bab679) is a multiplayer-friendly add-on that grants you the power to teleport yourself to preset locations - or your fellow players - in the blink of an eye. That can be hugely convenient, in much the same way I'd find it very convenient to be able to teleport to Rome whenever I crave a tiramisu.

Before we go any further, let me ask you a question: have you ever wished you could ctrl+z your own decisions? While the eggheads at MIT tell me that they "believe the imminent development of such technology is unlikely" and that I should "please stop sending such desperate emails about it", [Uncrafter+ 2.1 Add-on by Dalibu Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/dalibu-studios/uncrafter+-2.1-add--on/943a10e3-1001-4cae-a18b-5109dee023bd) is the next best thing. This powerful add-on lets you break crafted blocks back into their constituent parts. Excitingly, it works with a huge variety of other add-ons, allowing you to dismantle, disassemble, and otherwise undo whatever dubious crafting decisions you might have made.

[

[

[

Next up, nature! It's beautiful in the abstract, but the reality is that it's covered in mud and crawling with horrible bugs. That's why I've been using [Auto Farming Add-on by Block Perfect Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/block-perfect-studios/auto-farming-add--on/bfd4c18e-43c5-4709-94eb-73ca11ef25c9), which lets me grow productive crops inside pristine glass containers. Not only can these handsome vessels be used to create sprawling auto-harvesting farms, they also mean I don't suffer the indignity of getting soil under my freshly manicured fingernails. Ideal.

Now I don't know about you, but the raw, physical effort of creating this article has unleashed a powerful hunger in me. Fortunately, [Food Expansion by Mine-North](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/mine--north/food-expansion/c83c084e-c0d3-4e40-afc6-2b09134ab6a6) is here to satisfy my appetite with a smorgasbord of culinary delights. There's dozens of new dishes to savor, along with new crops to cultivate and farming vehicles to drive around in a state of postprandial bliss.

TEXTURE PACKS

Give your worlds a lick of crusty, medieval paint with [Excalibur by Syclone Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/syclone-studios/excalibur/bc756e7f-ab6d-4316-8a0f-9541c3bfe118), a texture pack that drapes everything from blocks to mobs to UI elements in ye olde finery. The overall effect is so thoroughly middle ages-y that I found myself forming strong opinions on feudalism, the three-field system of crop rotation, and the shifting balance between royal and baronial power. You know, medieval stuff.

Next up, we have a texture pack for the purists. Do you consider 16x16 textures the height of decadent excess? Do you long for simpler, more pared-back textures? Then look no further than [Vanilla 8x by Giggle Block Studios](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/giggle-block-studios/vanilla-8x/e714ceb0-5c8e-4979-962c-40ca0a1d9aa9), which lends Minecraft a pleasingly streamlined, almost minimalist look - like a gorgeous work of modern art. But with more creepers.

SKIN PACKS

[

Ever wished that half of your body was replaced with that of a giant, muscular fish? Of course you have! [Mermaids Skin Pack by CupcakeBrianna](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/cupcakebrianna/mermaids-skin-pack/8c047de0-e4ed-4f4b-8ac0-b5ac342921a3) lets you live out your piscine dreams with 11 detailed mermaid skins in a variety of colors. Take to the water to live your best mermaid life! Or just waddle around on dry land to really freak those landlubbers out.

Next up, we have a skin pack so adventurous that it would scale the world's tallest mountains - if it wasn't cruelly held back by the fact that it's just downloadable software and doesn't have a physical form. Shed a tear, then, for [Adventurers by Gamefam](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/marketplace/pdp/gamefam/adventurers/fe060ccb-2011-4251-b4f1-980dda3f98d0). It may never summit Everest, but it does feature eight bold, intrepid skins equipped with rugged outdoor gadgetry befitting their dauntless dispositions.

CHARACTER CREATOR ITEMS

The final items on our bumper list of treats making their way to Marketplace Pass this month are themed around the most frightening object known to humankind: the spooky skeleton. I'm sure you'll agree that it was very brave of me to even attempt to write about these Character Creator items, much less to assemble them in a gorgeously formatted bullet-point list.

● RGB Skeleton Head by CubeCraft Games

● Dark Scary Wings by Street Studios

● RGB Skeleton Pants by CubeCraft Games

● RGB Skeleton Top by CubeCraft Games

● Black Bold Glow Fire hands by Horizon Blocks

● Abyss Feet by Meraki

And there we have it: another month that is sure to go down in the history books principally for reasons relating to Minecraft Marketplace. I've never actually met a historian, but I assume that's what they're all up to, right?

Something in this list of goodies caught your eye? All you need to do is sign up to [Marketplace Pass](https://www.minecraft.net/marketplace/marketplace-pass) today to gain access to this treasure trove of mini games, add-ons, textures packs, and more. Or, if you're the sociable type, you could subscribe to [Realms Plus](https://www.minecraft.net/realms/bedrock) to get all this and an always-online server for you and up to 10 friends to stomp around in.

item.title: 测试我们即将推出的新版本中的更多功能
item.description: Starting this week, testing players can discover maps in abandoned camps and build with concrete slabs and stairs. Both features are out now in Java snapshot and coming very soon to Bedrock beta & preview.
item.content:encoded:
原标题：Test more features from our upcoming drop

作者：Cristina Anderca

原文：https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/drop-3-2026-final-testing

[

{

"id": "t0000",

"text": "像许多勇敢的Minecraft社区先锋一样，过去几周我一直在探索那片斑驳的森林，寻找被遗弃的营地。不过测试新功能是一项严肃的工作！要是我有个地方可以休息就好了……"

As if abandoned camps weren’t mysterious enough, now some of them contain maps hidden inside their chests! These maps lead to other abandoned camps or various other types of structures in the Overworld. The only way to find out exactly where is to just head there! Wait, did you hear that? I think that’s the sound of adventure calling...

Concrete slabs & stairs

Builders can now make more with concrete! Now you can build with concrete stairs and slabs in all 16 colors – simply combine a dye of your choice with sand and gravel to get your desired hue of concrete dust, place it in water to make a concrete block and then craft your concrete blocks into stairs or slabs. Or you can just grab it from the Creative inventory – I won’t tell.

A recap of the features released so far

In case you missed it, two weeks ago we released the first set of features from this drop! These include:

Cushions

Finally, a place to just sit down and take a breath! Or tell a story. Or enjoy a meal. Or just stare at a campfire. Cushions can be found in abandoned camps or crafted using 3 wool slabs of the same color. Cushions are a game changer when it comes to decorating your base or creating more lifelike builds. Now you can have the sectional of your dreams or a more realistic stadium! The sky Y = 320 is the limit.

Straw beds

Found in abandoned camps or crafted using 3 hay bales, straw beds are the easiest way to sleep through the night, oblivious to its horrors. Just remember that they are consumable, and they won’t reset your spawn point! As my back can attest to, cheap comfort has its tradeoffs, but there’s no feeling it like roughing it in nature.

The dappled forest

This welcoming, warm-toned biome is equally inviting and intriguing. Walk amongst the poplar trees and red shrubs, and who knows what you might stumble upon. Is that a tent?... Wonder who left that here.

The abandoned camp

This mysterious structure can appear in any biome. An empty tent, a campfire, a straw bed, a cushion... and some loot? Who built this and where have they gone? Light a fire, take a seat, and ponder that as the sun sets. It may be abandoned, but it’s a precious shelter.

Wool slabs and stairs

Our woolliest block set has two soft additions: stairs and slabs! Craft them in any of the 16 colors to add smoother shapes, layered textures, and creative details to everything from custom furniture to cozy hideouts ready for crisp nights in the wilderness.

[

{"id": "t0019", "translated_text": "杨树、红色灌木和架子蘑菇"},

{"id": "t0020", "translated_text": "这片斑驳的森林色彩丰富，植物和真菌种类繁多。欣赏杨树叶子的美丽色彩，然后砍下一棵杨树获取杨木，用杨木可以制作出整套所需物品。摘一株红色灌木带回家，为你的基地增添一抹色彩。多功能的架子蘑菇生长在杨树上——你可以踩在它们上面，用它们烹饪，或者给它们喂食骨粉，看着它们慢慢成长。"},

{"id": "t0021", "translated_text": "准备好你的探险装备，出发吧！在Java版本的快照更新以及Bedrock版的测试和预览版中，等待着你的是迄今为止最精彩的冒险。",

You can test these features by enabling snapshots for Minecraft: Java Edition, or by enabling previews/beta** for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition. To install a snapshot, open up the Minecraft Launcher and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab. To turn on an experiment in preview/beta for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition [follow these instructions](https://www.minecraft.net/article/how-get-minecraft-betas).

Send us your feedback!

These features are all still in development, which means that the details outlined above might change as we iterate on them. So then why have we released them into testing? Because we want your feedback! [Send us your thoughts](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/community/topics/46325722710285) and report bugs at [bugs.mojang.com](https://bugs.mojang.com/)!

*Editor’s note: Any claims made by the author about their own bravery, daring, grit, or other similar qualities are purely deluded subjective and do not represent the collective opinion of Minecraft.net’s editorial team.

**New features are coming in the future and will require Minecraft Bedrock Edition or Java Edition (each sold separately). As development is ongoing, the features shown and their descriptions are subject to change. Feedback from the community will help us iterate these features into their final versions.

item.title: Minecraft 26.3 快照 7
item.content:encoded:
原标题：Minecraft 26.3 Snapshot 7

作者：Java Team

原文：https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/minecraft-26-3-snapshot-7

Step up your building and exploring with the final features entering testing! You can now find different maps in some abandoned camps and craft Concrete Stairs & Slabs in 16 colors. Out now in 26.3 Snapshot 7!

Happy exploring!

New Features

  • Added Concrete Stairs and Concrete Slabs for all Concrete blocks
  • New Explorer Maps have been added to the Abandoned Camps

    • Abandoned Camp Explorer Maps

  • Added maps showing the location of other Abandoned Camps in the following biomes:
  • Bamboo Jungle
  • Cherry Grove
  • Birch Forest
  • Dappled Forest
  • Flower Forest
  • Pale Garden
  • Swamp
  • Windswept Forest
  • Added maps for the following structures:
  • Ancient City
  • Trial Chambers
  • Mineshaft
  • Desert Pyramid
  • Jungle Pyramid
  • Warm Ocean Ruins
  • Woodland Mansion

    • Changes

  • Cushions no longer prevent vibrations when placed, broken or interacted with
  • Updated loot table for the Abandoned Camp Barrel
  • Replaced Firework Rocket with Gunpowder in Abandoned Camp Chest loot table
  • The player icon on maps have been updated to always show the direction the player is facing
  • Added support for Realms to use additional server regions in Canada, Mexico, South Africa, and Arizona, USA if they become available in the future

    • Explorer Maps

  • Explorer Maps are now their own items instead of renamed Filled Maps, and each has its own icon:
  • Ocean Explorer Map
  • Woodland Explorer Map
  • Trial Explorer Map
  • Jungle Explorer Map
  • Swamp Explorer Map
  • Desert Village Map
  • Plains Village Map
  • Savanna Village Map
  • Snowy Village Map
  • Taiga Village Map
  • Buried Treasure Map
  • Ancient City Map
  • Mineshaft Map
  • Desert Pyramid Map
  • Abandoned Campsite Map
  • Warm Ocean Ruins Map
  • Map and Empty Map have new icons
  • These items cannot be obtained from the Creative inventory
  • Existing Explorer Maps in old worlds are converted to the matching new item on load
  • [
  • {
  • "id": "t0050",
  • "text": "探索者地图仍然可以在制作台中克隆，而且克隆出来的地图会保留原有的物品类型。"
  • },

  • "id": "t0051",

  • },
  • {
  • If omitted, defaults to whack
  • Added a new argument to set the duration of the swing animation, if provided
  • Format: positive time value (by default in ticks)
  • If omitted, defaults to 6t

    • Data Components

    Added minecraft:attack_animation

  • The animation to play when the item is being used to attack something
  • Format: object with fields:
  • type - swing animation type, one of whack or stab
  • duration - positive integer, the length of the animation in ticks

    • Added minecraft:interact_animation

  • The animation to play when the item is being used to interact with something
  • Format: Same as minecraft:attack_animation

    • Removed minecraft:swing_animation

  • This has been replaced by minecraft:attack_animation and minecraft:interact_animation
  • The none swing animation type has been removed
  • Existing items in the world will be migrated to using the default whack
  • Setting both of these new components to the same value will be functionally identical to the old component, except for:
  • The /swing command - animation type now specified by the command
  • Items being dropped by entities

    • Removed minecraft:map_color

  • Maps are no longer drawn as a tinted overlay, so there is nothing left for the color to apply to
  • Existing maps have the component stripped on load
  • See the Resource Pack section for the matching removal of the minecraft:map_color tint source

    • Loot Functions

    Changed minecraft:exploration_map

  • The map_color field has now been removed
  • The function no longer changes the type of the item it is applied to - it now only adds map data to the existing item
  • Previously it required a minecraft:map and produced a minecraft:filled_map
  • The item to produce is now chosen by the loot entry or villager trade itself, so a data pack that produced exploration maps has to change its item from minecraft:map to minecraft:filled_map (or one of the explorer map items)
  • If no matching structure is found, the item is left without a minecraft:map_id - use minecraft:filtered with minecraft:discard_item to drop those, as the vanilla loot tables and villager trades now do

    • Density Functions

  • Density Functions and noises are no longer evaluated with double-precision floating point values, but instead with single-precision
  • This affects all intermediate steps, not just the final result
    • Developer's Note: _We are aware that the details of floating point rounding have been used in some Data Packs, and this change may affect specific configurations. We have introduced alternatives for the use-cases that we are aware of, but please do share with us on [feedback.minecraft.net](https://feedback.minecraft.net) or in the [feedback Discord](https://discord.com/invite/minecraftfeedback) if you encounter use-cases that are no longer possible to support.

    Tags

    Block Tags

  • Added #concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs blocks
  • Added #concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs blocks

    • Item Tags

  • Added #concrete_stairs - All Concrete Stairs items
  • Added #concrete_slabs - All Concrete Slabs items
  • Added #cloneable_maps - Filled Map plus all Explorer Map items and Buried Treasure Maps, used as the input to the map_cloning recipe
  • Added #extendable_maps - maps that can be zoomed out with paper, either in a Crafting Table or at a Cartography Table

    • Resource Pack Version 95.0

    Item Sprites

  • Removed item/filled_map_markings.png

    • Map Sprites

  • Added new Map textures:
  • abandoned_camp.png
  • ancient_city.png

  • mineshaft.png

  • The following Icons have been updated in order to show player rotation on the map:
  • /player.png

item.title: 在线游玩《OneBlock》
item.description: Play OneBlock Online and take on the classic Minecraft skyblock-inspired challenge with friends. Start with a single regenerating OneBlock, grow your island, unlock permanent upgrades, and automate your base with helpful minions. Head out to battle custom monsters, earn powerful gear and enchantments, compete in PvP, and decorate your island with over 1,000 furniture items. With a player-driven economy, regular events, leaderboards, and plenty more to discover, OneBlock Online is packed with reasons to keep coming back.
item.content:encoded:
原标题：Play OneBlock Online

作者：Cristina Anderca

原文：https://www.minecraft.net/zh-hans/article/oneblock-online

It starts with one block. I don’t know why, but no matter how many times I mine it, it doesn’t break. And yet my inventory is filling up with a variety of blocks?... It’s OneBlock, of course! This is the iconic Minecraft game mode that challenges you to expand your domain in the sky – now with friends! OneBlock Online not only introduces multiplayer, but also improved automation systems, long-term progression systems that will keep your island interesting for years to come, and more. Jump into this multiplayer adventure now via the Server tab in Bedrock Edition!

Your OneBlock, islands, and co-op

You start with a single OneBlock on your island, which progresses through 29 unique phases, each yielding increasingly valuable loot. We'll also add more phases, blocks, and items in future updates!

Aside from mining, you can complete daily and weekly quests to gain XP and spend it on permanent island upgrades such as increased island size, faster crop growth, improved spawner rates, and more!

Plus, not only can you own multiple islands, but each island also supports multiple OneBlocks, so you can invite friends to join you so you can work together.

Monster islands, bone forge, and enchantments

Want more loot than your OneBlock has to offer? Travel to a monster island and fight your way to rare drops and other rewards. Progress through increasingly difficult islands with custom monsters that bring some serious challenge to the OneBlock experience.

[

{

"id": "t0007",

But it’s not all about productivity! After all, what’s the point of having an island if you can’t decorate it? Visit the furniture shop to peruse a catalog of over 1000 items, as well as rotating seasonal furniture items for the collectors out there. You can also customize your character with chat titles, pins, wings, hats, chat colors, and more!

But that’s only part of what OneBlock Online has to offer. This multiplayer adventure also features a player-based economy, a rewarded leaderboard system, and server-wide events that range from fishing rewards to double XP and PvP competitions.

Ready to become the ruler of your own island? See how far you can get in OneBlock Online!
